plugins.name: 1xops
plugins.description: Build your own plugin from approved, tested parts, starting from a job your team already does. Licence and origin kept; nothing ships unreviewed. Installs 12 library plugins it builds from: operations, cowork-plugin-management, customer-support, data, engineering, enterprise-search, finance, human-resources, marketing, product-management, sales, small-business.
